name: Keith J. Green

items.why: The item is an opinion column and editorial, plus a lawful $1,000 PAC donation and independent PAC messaging, with no finding or documented conduct by Green on big money (criterion 3) or abuse of office.

for_review: The Bradenton Times news report (Oct 3, Dawn Kitterman) confirms Christian Family Coalition Manatee PAC gave Green a $1,000 maximum contribution and sent texts promoting him. It does not say Green coordinated with the PAC, and it contains no response from him. Green is not accused of wrongdoing. The 'malleable on developer influence' line is only an editorial opinion, and the paper's endorsement of his opponent gives no specific examples. The Oct 24 column is mostly about the PAC operators and their lobbyists, not Green. The column's own claim that Green was 'backed by developer-aligned groups' was not verified from official finance records. I did not open the state Division of Elections committee page or Green's full voterfocus filings. Green skipped the League of Women Voters forum. That is a campaign choice, not weighed here. The Nov 3 results (Yahoo) show Green lost to Gonzalez Moore, about 44% to 56% (unofficial). A search pairing Green with the owner's followed sites returned nothing about him. No further searches were used on other possible matters.
